verses.text: Ha winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro, ix yak'kot schekab' winh t'a winhaj rey David. Ix yak'anpaxkot heb' albañil winh yet' heb' nhikum te', ix yik'ankot te' k'ute' heb' yik sb'ochaj spalacio winhaj rey David chi'.
Yuj chi' ix nachajel yuj winhaj rey David chi' to a Jehová ix ak'anoch winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel. Ix ik'jicha'anh yopisio winh yuj Jehová yujto xajan chonhab' Israel yuj.
Ay juntzanhxo heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj rey David ix yik' t'a Jerusalén, yuj chi' ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil ix alji yet' heb' ix.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji t'a Jerusalén chi', haton winhaj Samúa, winhaj Sobab, winhaj Natán, winhaj Salomón,
winhaj Ibhar, winhaj Elisúa, winhaj Elpelet,
winhaj Noga, winhaj Nefeg, winhaj Jafía,
winhaj Elisama, winhaj Beeliada yet' winhaj Elifelet.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' filisteo to toxo ix och winhaj David sreyalok masanil heb' israel, ix och ijan heb' sayan tas tz'aj yak'an ganar, palta elanhchamel ix yab' winh, ix elta winh t'a yichanh heb' chi'.
Ix jawi heb' filisteo chi' yak' chukal t'a heb' anima kajan t'a sch'olanil Refaim.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj rey David t'a Dios icha tik: --¿Tzam yal wak'an owal yet' heb' filisteo tik? ¿Ol am ak'och heb' t'a yol in k'ab'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh: --Ak' owal yet' heb', yujto ol wak'och heb' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix k'e winhaj rey David b'aj ayek' heb' filisteo chi'. Hata' ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj winh. Ix yalan winh icha tik: Icha wal tz'aj sjakan sb'e junok ha' eluma', icha chi' ix aj sjakan b'e Jehová t'ayin t'a skal heb' wajk'o'ol, xchi winh. Yuj chi' Baal-perazim ix yak' winh sb'iej jun lugar chi'.
Ix yaktejkan juntzanh sdiosal heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix schek winhaj rey David chi' nhusjoktz'aok.
Palta a heb' filisteo chi', ix jaxxi heb' t'a sch'olanil yik Refaim chi'.

Yuj chi', ix sk'anb'ejxi winhaj rey David chi' t'a Dios, ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, manh ach och t'a sat heb' ak'an owal, palta to ha t'a spatik heb' tzach koti, b'aj ay te' bálsamo.

Ayik ol ab'ani ichato ay mach wan sb'eyek' t'a sk'ab'tak te te' chi', tzach och ak' owal yet' heb'. Ha jun chi' syalelk'ochi to a in ol in b'ab'laj t'a eyichanh yik tzin milancham heb' soldado filisteo chi', xchi Jehová.
Icha ix aj yalan Dios, icha wal chi' ix yutej winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix satel heb' soldado filisteo chi', ix b'atnhej t'a Gabaón masanto ix k'och t'a Gezer.
Icha wal chi' ix aj sk'echa'anh sb'inajnakil winhaj rey David t'a masanil nación. Ha Jehová ix ak'an xiwk'e masanil nación chi' t'a winh.
